chapter.heading: Simple Trust in the LordA Song of Ascents. Of David.
chapter.v:
Lord, my
heart is not haughty,Nor my eyes lofty.Neither do I concern myself with great matters,Nor with things too profound for me.

Surely I
have calmed and quieted my soul,Like a weaned child with his mother;Like a weaned child is my soul within me.

O Israel,
hope in the LordFrom this time forth and forever.
